frozen_rule.selection_rule: For target t, choose the component with the largest arithmetic mean of its cached OOS main-hit count over targets t-100 through t-1; score only the chosen component's hit count at target t.

inference.rng: Mulberry32, paired resample stream for both primary comparisons

verification.lookback_rule: At target t, select using only target outcomes t-100 through t-1.
